Existing exact synthetic 155-byte JPEG and 640-byte PDF recipes/digests; no native-custody claim.

assignedObservableMatchingContract.M1: One explicitly selected complete signed-rule body; no automatic selection or permission merging.
assignedObservableMatchingContract.M2: Exact expected policy/publication/branch coordinates and action. Company scope remains a required production gate where bounded-field binding is unavailable.
assignedObservableMatchingContract.M3: Exact authoritative supplier and every product/revision/catalog release; no category membership inferred from names.
assignedObservableMatchingContract.M4: Actual public PERFORM AuthorizedAction, independently expected original requester identity and operation-bound AuthorizationRequirement. Proof cannot adopt a different original actor. Direct has no approval coordinates; Separate has distinct actual actors; NamedSelf is the Separate route with equality allowed only for the selected rule's explicit named account, while distinct authorized actors remain eligible. Fresh grants are external.
assignedObservableMatchingContract.M5: Independently ordered operation-bound selected manifests and corresponding resolved current original metadata; zero-to-two originals, required/optional presence, exact media/purpose/supplier/scope/identity/storage revision/length/digest and order constraints. Master alone establishes normalized request and current byte/history authority.
assignedObservableMatchingContract.M6: Explicit exact selected retention class/revision; no default retention or disposal authority. Required policy/company/branch provenance remains production/unbound where the public bounded input cannot observe it.
assignedObservableMatchingContract.M7: Mismatch on violated supplied constraints. Agreement is only a bounded comparison, never signed/current-source/authority/commit/history qualification and never an effect. Genuine production gates remain NOT_RUN.

correctionPolicy: Preserve these inputs and expectations. Any clarification that changes an expectation needs an additive separately versioned requirements rationale; wiring does not relax a refusal or promote NOT_RUN to PASS.
